name: 48415 · Birch Run, MI
findings: ZIP 48415 (Birch Run) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48415 (Birch Run) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48415 (Birch Run) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).
